question: What are the two things needed to play the game Gilli Danda? 🪵
explanation: Awesome! To play Gilli Danda, you need a long stick (Danda) to hit a smaller oval stick (Gilli)! 🪵
hint: Both items are made of wood.

question: Where is the best place to play Gilli Danda? 🌳
explanation: Great job! Gilli Danda is an outdoor game, so we play it in a big open playground! 🌳
hint: You need lots of space to run.

question: What do we call the long stick used to hit in the game? 🏏
explanation: Super! The long, strong wooden stick is called the Danda! 🏏

question: What do we call the small stick that flies in the air? 🚀
explanation: Awesome! The small, pointed stick that you hit is called the Gilli! 🚀
hint: It is the first word in the game's name.

question: What are the Gilli and Danda made from? 🌳
explanation: Perfect! Both the Gilli and the Danda are carved from strong wood! 🪵

question: What shape are the ends of the small Gilli? ✏️
explanation: Great job! The Gilli has pointed ends so it can jump up when you tap it! ✏️
hint: Like the tip of a pencil.

question: Who do we play Gilli Danda with? 👫
explanation: Awesome! Playing games is always much more fun with our friends! 👫

question: What do you do with the Danda? 🏏
explanation: Super! You hold the Danda tight and use it to hit the Gilli far away! 💥
hint: You swing it like a bat.

question: What happens if a friend catches the Gilli in the air? 👐
explanation: Perfect! Just like in cricket, if someone catches the flying Gilli, the hitter is out! 👐
hint: The hitter has to drop the stick.

question: How do we feel when we play games outside? 😃
explanation: Great job! Running and playing games outside makes us feel very happy and healthy! 🏃
hint: It brings a big smile to your face.

question: What is drawn on the ground to start the game? ⭕
explanation: Awesome! A small circle or hole is made on the ground to place the Gilli! ⭕
hint: It is round like a ring.

question: What sound does the wood make when the Danda hits the Gilli? 🎵
explanation: Super! When two pieces of wood hit each other, they make a loud 'clack' sound! 🪵

question: Which stick is much longer? 📏
explanation: Perfect! The Danda is the longer stick that you hold in your hands! 📏

question: Which stick is much smaller? 🤏
explanation: Great job! The Gilli is the small stick that goes flying into the sky! 🚀

question: What do we use to run after the flying Gilli? 🏃
explanation: Awesome! We use our strong legs to run fast across the playground! 🏃
hint: They are attached to your feet.

question: What do you use to hold the Danda tightly? ✊
explanation: Super! We grip the Danda firmly with our hands to take a good swing! ✊

question: If you lose the game today, what should you do? 😊
explanation: Perfect! Good players always smile, clap for friends, and try again next time! 👏

question: What should you do if a friend falls while playing? 🤝
explanation: Great job! Good friends always care for each other and help each other get up! 🤝

question: How do we show good sportsmanship? 🏆
explanation: Awesome! Cheering for our friends makes the game fun and shows good sportsmanship! 👏

question: When the game is over, what do players do? 🤝
explanation: Super! Shaking hands shows respect and friendship after a great game! 🤝

question: Playing outdoor games like Gilli Danda makes our body...? 💪
explanation: Perfect! Running and playing outside keeps our muscles strong and healthy! 💪

question: When someone hits the Gilli very far, we say...? 🌟
explanation: Great job! We should always praise our friends when they do something amazing! 🌟

question: Playing in teams helps us learn how to...? 🤝
explanation: Awesome! Team games teach us how to share, work together, and have fun! 🤝

question: What is the opposite of a 'Big Danda'? 🤏
explanation: Super! The Danda is big and long, while the Gilli is small and short! 🤏
hint: The other stick in the game.

question: Where does the Gilli fly when you hit it hard? ☁️
explanation: Perfect! A good hit makes the little Gilli zoom high up into the air! ☁️

question: Why do children love playing Gilli Danda? 😄
explanation: Great job! Games are meant to be exciting, active, and full of joy and fun! 😄

question: What part of your body do you use to look at the flying Gilli? 👀
explanation: Awesome! We use our eyes to watch carefully where the Gilli is going! 👀

question: If you want to catch the Gilli, you might need to...? 🦘
explanation: Super! Sometimes the Gilli flies so high that we have to jump up to catch it! 🦘

question: Gilli Danda is a very old and famous game from which country? 🇮🇳
explanation: Perfect! Gilli Danda is a lovely traditional game that children play in India! 🇮🇳

question: What is the action of grabbing the flying Gilli called? 👐
explanation: Great job! Grabbing the Gilli with your hands before it hits the ground is catching! 👐

question: What is a large, open grassy area meant for playing called? 🏞️
explanation: Awesome! A playground is a wide, safe space outside for running and games! 🏞️

question: After playing outside in the sun, you should drink lots of...? 💧
explanation: Super! Playing makes us thirsty, so drinking fresh water keeps us healthy! 💧

question: Tapping the tip of the Gilli makes it...? 🦘
explanation: Perfect! Because the ends are pointed, tapping it makes the Gilli jump up! 🦘

question: What do we wear on our feet to run safely while playing? 👟
explanation: Great job! Good shoes protect our feet so we can run fast without getting hurt! 👟

question: When it is your turn, you take the Danda and...? 🏏
explanation: Awesome! When it's your turn, you stand strong and get ready to hit! 🏏

question: The children in the story are playing as a...? 🤝
explanation: Super! Playing in teams helps children work together and share the fun! 🤝

question: What tool helps you hit the Gilli as hard as you can? 💪
explanation: Perfect! The Danda is the long, hard tool you use to hit the Gilli super far! 🏏

question: What must the other players do while you hit the Gilli? 👀
explanation: Great job! The fielders must watch the Gilli closely so they can try to catch it! 👀

question: If you cannot catch the Gilli, you have to...? 🏃
explanation: Awesome! If the Gilli falls, the fielders have to run fast to pick it up! 🏃

question: Playing Gilli Danda requires lots of...? ⚡
explanation: Super! Running, hitting, and catching take a lot of fun, bouncy energy! ⚡

question: Which of these games is played with sticks? 🪵
explanation: Perfect! Gilli Danda is a special game played with two wooden sticks! 🪵

question: How do children sound when they play games together? 😂
explanation: Great job! Playgrounds are always full of happy laughs and loud cheers! 😂

question: What is the very first thing you do with the Gilli? ⛳
explanation: Awesome! You place the small Gilli on the ground over a little hole to start! ⛳

question: What word rhymes with 'Hit'? ⚾
explanation: Super! 'Hit' and 'Sit' sound exactly the same at the end! 🪑

question: What do we learn from playing outdoor games? 🤝
explanation: Perfect! Games teach us how to work together as a happy team! 🤝

question: What season is great for playing Gilli Danda outside? ☀️
explanation: Great job! A bright, sunny day is the perfect time to play outside! ☀️

question: If your friend hits the Gilli, you should try to...? 👐
explanation: Awesome! Trying to catch the Gilli makes the game exciting and gets them out! 👐

question: What feeling do you get when you catch the flying Gilli? 🏆
explanation: Super! Catching a fast Gilli is hard, so it makes you feel very proud and happy! 🏆

question: Why do we draw a circle on the ground? ⭕
explanation: Perfect! The circle marks the starting spot where the hitter stands! ⭕
hint: A line to show where to start.

question: What is the best part of playing Gilli Danda? 😊
explanation: Great job! The absolute best part of any game is laughing and having fun with friends! 😊
